title: FLUX.2-klein-9B-Nunchaku
summary: A 4-bit quantized version of Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 [klein] model optimized for low-latency image generation. It leverages the Nunchaku SVDQuant engine to achieve sub-second inference speeds on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Reduces peak VRAM requirements from 18.5GB to approximately 6.4GB, enabling the 9B parameter model to run on mid-range GPUs like the RTX 3060.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from the Jan 2026 FLUX.2 [klein] release into a highly optimized production tool through the integration of the Nunchaku acceleration engine. A specialized KV-cache variant was subsequently released in April 2026 to speed up multi-reference editing.
